description: Extracts Virginia DMAS HIPP application fields from classified documents using OCR, layout analysis, and source confidence. Household members are emitted as explicitly named scalar fields so repeated form labels can be resolved by their numbered household section.

fieldSchema.name: HippApplication
fieldSchema.description: Fields captured from a Virginia DMAS HIPP application or HIPP correspondence form.

ApplicationId.description: The HIPP application identifier, usually printed near the form heading.

CorrespondenceType.description: The selected HIPP correspondence type: New HIPP application, Quarterly Paystub Submission, Annual HIPP Renewal, or Information change.

HippNumber.description: The five-digit HIPP number, when present.

PolicyholderDateOfBirth.description: Policyholder or employee date of birth.

Household1stPersonFirstName.description: First name from the 1st Person in Household section; do not use the policyholder's name.

Household1stPersonMiddleInitial.description: Middle initial from the 1st Person in Household section.

Household1stPersonLastName.description: Last name from the 1st Person in Household section.

Household1stPersonDateOfBirth.description: Date of birth from the 1st Person in Household section.

Household1stPersonRelationship.description: Selected relationship to the policyholder from the 1st Person in Household section.

Household1stPersonOtherRelationship.description: Other relationship text from the 1st Person in Household section, when Other is selected.

Household1stPersonGetsMedicaid.description: Whether the 1st Person in Household gets Medicaid.

Household1stPersonMedicaidId.description: Medicaid ID from the 1st Person in Household section.

Household1stPersonGetsMedicare.description: Whether the 1st Person in Household gets Medicare.

Household1stPersonCoveredByInsurance.description: Whether the 1st Person in Household is covered under the policyholder's insurance.

Household1stPersonSocialSecurityNumber.description: Social Security Number from the 1st Person in Household section.
